snippet.description:
A film can do more than tell a story. It can open up conversations we don't always make time for.

At LevelUp IAS, we brought mental health into focus through a movie screening, followed by a discussion with Sonali Ma’am.

Coming up this Sunday: *Posture, Pain & Movement During UPSC Preparation*, a free offline workshop with Dr. Rachita Luthra, Musculoskeletal Physiotherapist, in conversation with Sonali Ma’am.

📅 25 October | 10 AM  
📍 LevelUp IAS, New Delhi

Register here: https://shorturl.at/xhZuA

📞 For queries: 8826496658


Meet us - 📍Location: LevelUp IAS, Karol Bagh Centre; Google Map - https://maps.app.goo.gl/6brt5mwLSFhENRCq8
Address - 2nd Floor, 45 Pusa Road, Opp. Metro Pillar 128, Karol Bagh
